source_row.rationale: Apixaban has fixed labeled dosing schemes based on indication and specified patient factors rather than routine INR-guided titration. Clinical follow-up, renal/hepatic assessment when appropriate, adherence review, and bleeding surveillance remain important; the absence of routine INR dose adjustment does not mean monitoring is unnecessary.
source_row.source_detail: Dosage and Administration section 2.1: indication-specific fixed dosing and NVAF dose-reduction criteria; INR-based titration is not part of labeled apixaban dosing.
source_row.stem: A client with nonvalvular atrial fibrillation is switched from warfarin to apixaban and asks whether INR testing will be used routinely to adjust the apixaban dose. Which response is most accurate?
